gaps.text: The public plans:get verification summary does not resolve a namespaced built-in item type consistently with its short alias. In scratch plan blind-review-scratch-43c0d8a82037-coding-2026-10-24, plans:add-item accepted P-001 with deliverable:'papercusp/doc' and P-002 with deliverable:'doc'. plan-types:get identifies papercusp/doc as the Document type with modules:['generic-core']. Reading the scratch plan shows both deliverables stored correctly, but verification.overrides contains only P-002/doc with generic-core; verification.itemTypes is empty and the plan default remains generic-core+code. Thus the namespaced, reusable identity is missing from the public effective-verification summary. Generalizing item types is only partly reflected in this product read surface. This finding concerns the returned summary; the review did not establish that the completion or ship gate applies incorrect modules.
